scope: Three actual saved-native raster views, including the fixed inherited source overlay; source images inspected separately.
findings: The oblique shows the outer flanged sleeve, its radial opening and the adjacent thin retaining ring. The large brake drum obscures much of the inner sleeve from this direction; the axial section supplies that view.

The native axial section exposes both sleeves, their recessed dowel positions and the two shaft grooves. The C-ring opening is an inferred radial gap and accounts for the absent ring segment on one side of this cut. It is not an omitted occurrence.

The source overlay uses the unchanged four-inch sprocket hub scale. Bush axial regions and retaining stations broadly follow Plate22. Flange contours, hole direction and diameters remain inferred; source irregularity and the existing six-pixel drum/shaft-axis residual are retained.

The displayed shaft/drum/sprocket interfaces remain distinct native components. New bushes and dowels follow an explicit rotating-sleeve hypothesis informed by the separate poured-babbitt housing note; geometric fit does not resolve that historical interface alone.

All825 native leaves are valid single solids. Twelve new occurrences match the selected SNL counts. Four journal gaps, four dowel capture checks, four bidirectional ring capture checks and four retained spline-interface checks pass. Fixed bearing castings, lining, complete axial stack and transmission installation remain incomplete.
No change to the qualified standard tank or previous progression images. This is an isolated installation candidate, not milestone012.
